proposed_sites.reason: Module-level assignment to openai.api_key must become explicit client construction (client = OpenAI(api_key=...)) under the v1.x SDK.
openai.ChatCompletion.create is a v0.x module-level namespaced call; in v1.x it must be client.chat.completions.create(...).
openai.error.RateLimitError no longer exists in v1.x; exceptions moved to top-level openai.RateLimitError.
openai.error.ServiceUnavailableError no longer exists in v1.x; exceptions moved to top-level openai namespace.
